## 🐛 Fixed

- **Web office editor iframe blocked by OpenCloud's own Content-Security-Policy.** Registering a WOPI document server (Euro Office, Collabora, OnlyOffice) via the **Office document server URL** field did not add that server's origin to OpenCloud's `frame-src`/`img-src` CSP directives, so the browser silently blocked the editor iframe with a CSP violation even though the WOPI wiring itself was correct. The wrapper now generates that CSP addition automatically whenever web office is enabled, no manual `csp.yaml` needed. If you already point OpenCloud at your own custom CSP file via `PROXY_CSP_CONFIG_FILE_LOCATION`, the wrapper leaves it untouched; add your document server's origin to its `frame-src`/`img-src` yourself.
